titulo: How to say no to plans: 4 texts
caption:
How to say no to plans: four texts that are honest and kind.
Save them for the next “you coming?”
Link in bio.
by NMR

alt.1: Video with our own music, 6 seconds, slow push-in on the cover. Cella looking at a big phone. Save · 4 texts to say no. How to say no to plans, kindly. 4 short texts. Copy and send.
alt.2: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. Too tired. I can't tonight. I'd be bad company. Next week? When you just can't tonight. Why it works: tired is a reason, not an apology.
alt.3: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. Not your thing. Thanks for thinking of me. That plan isn't for me. When you don't want to go at all. Why it works: it's about the plan, not them.
alt.4: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. Too full. I'm full this week. Can we pick a day next week? When your week has no room. Why it works: no comes with a new date.
alt.5: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. Need time alone. I need a day to myself. It's not about you. Talk soon? When you need a quiet day. Why it works: it says what it is not.
alt.6: the four texts as a list. The cheat sheet. Saying no, kindly: Cella said no twice today. Feeling great. Send this to someone who can't. 1. I'd be bad company. 2. That plan isn't for me. 3. Can we pick a day? 4. It's not about you.
